$comment: Cases that do not match Node yet, by target, each with its cause. The diff run reports them without failing, and fails when one matches Node so it is removed here. Owners: the Kotlin translator (src/kotlin.ts) and runtime (kit-android runtime).

swift.227-callback-given-undefined: A string parameter given undefined reads "", and a void promise's value is not undefined (Swift translator).
swift.231-regexp-unset-group: A capture group that took no part in the match reads "", not undefined (Swift translator).
swift.232-async-object-return: An object literal an async function returns is not made as its declared Promise's type (Swift translator).
swift.234-define-property-instance: Object.defineProperty on a class instance or an array is dropped (Swift translator and runtime, SEMANTICS #3).
swift.237-shared-top-names: Top-level names (an enum, files of the same name in two folders) that several modules declare clash; swiftc crashes (Swift translator).
swift.239-destructuring-assignment: Destructuring assignment to existing variables is refused (Swift translator, SEMANTICS #8).
swift.243-array-holes: Object.keys lists the holes of new Array(n) (Swift runtime).
swift.244-optional-member-later: An optional member set after the object is made is listed in declaration order, not as the last key (Swift translator).
swift.246-nullable-string-concat: `null as string | null` in a template or a concatenation does not compile: nil has no contextual type (Swift translator).
swift.247-missing-values-throw: A module const read before its declaration runs, and a member of undefined or null read, set or called, trap instead of throwing ReferenceError or TypeError (Swift translator, quality step 4).
swift.248-function-properties: Properties given to a function value (`fn.tag = …`, Object.defineProperty) and Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call on one are refused or dropped (Swift translator and runtime, SEMANTICS #3).
swift.249-literal-to-primitive: An object literal's own [Symbol.toPrimitive] is ignored, and a literal's valueOf is not called by < or Math.max (Swift translator, SEMANTICS #5).
swift.290-regexp-backtracking: A capture inside a quantified group keeps its value from an earlier iteration instead of resetting to undefined (NSRegularExpression semantics, Swift runtime).
swift.291-json-edges: A lone surrogate becomes U+FFFD because Swift strings hold only valid Unicode, and the circular-structure TypeError has an empty message (Swift runtime).
swift.293-array-sort-callbacks: A comparator declared with fewer parameters than sort passes does not compile (Swift translator).
swift.363-operator-pipe: An overloaded generic method with an `any` implementation (`pipe(...operators: OperatorFunction<any, any>[])`) is called as the implementation, and an overload's function argument names the implementation's type parameter `T` (Swift translator).
swift.620-interface-identity: An object read as an interface type twice is wrapped anew each time (an object already of the interface's class is kept), so the two are not === and a Map keyed by one misses the other (Swift translator).
swift.621-optional-callback-adapting: Lenient app code: a callback's boolean parameter given undefined holds false, and a function literal returning null where its type gives an array does not compile (Swift translator).
swift.624-json-parse-null: A non-strict function's string result that is null at run time is one nil with undefined, so JSON.parse of it throws as of undefined (Swift translator).
swift.626-array-parameter-mutation: A typed array or an untyped array given to a number[] parameter is copied, so the callee's writes are lost (Swift translator).
swift.627-unchecked-class-cast: `x as C` throws when x is an instance of another class, where TypeScript's cast checks nothing (Swift translator).

kotlin.250-void-promise-values: A function value with a rest parameter passed to then (`then(log)`) matches no overload (Kotlin translator).
kotlin.251-define-property-targets: A function declaration used as a value (`Object.defineProperty(greet, …)`) and `error.constructor.name` do not compile; defineProperty on a class's object, an array or a function is dropped, test262 cluster 3 (Kotlin translator and runtime).
kotlin.252-prototype-method-calls: A built-in's prototype method called with call or apply (`Array.prototype.slice.call(list, 1)`) is refused, test262 cluster 2 (Kotlin translator).
kotlin.254-destructuring-assignment: A rest element in a destructuring assignment (`[first, ...others] = list`) is refused, test262 cluster 8 (Kotlin translator).
kotlin.257-typeof-lenient-optional: Lenient code: a module or local `let x: boolean;` declared without a value holds false, not undefined (`isA11yEnabled()`); `typeof` of a function variable read from an optional member folds to "function"; `typeof val === 'string'` of a narrowed `string | string[]` parameter folds to true, so `enforceArray(undefined)` throws (Kotlin translator).
kotlin.270-json-edges: JSON.parse and JSON.stringify edges the Swift perf round covers: number forms, escapes, toJSON and replacer order, syntax error messages (Kotlin runtime, being fixed in the Kotlin perf work).
kotlin.620-interface-identity: An object read as an interface type is wrapped anew at each conversion, so the same object is not === itself (Kotlin translator).
kotlin.621-optional-callback-adapting: Lenient app code: a callback's boolean parameter given undefined holds false, `typeof` of an optional function parameter folds to "function", and a function literal returning null where its type gives an array gives undefined (Kotlin translator).
kotlin.624-json-parse-null: JSON.parse of a string that is null at run time parses "undefined" and throws (Kotlin translator).
kotlin.626-array-parameter-mutation: A typed array or an untyped array given to a number[] parameter is copied, so the callee's writes are lost (Kotlin translator).
kotlin.627-unchecked-class-cast: `x as C` throws when x is an instance of another class, where TypeScript's cast checks nothing (Kotlin translator).
